title: a tester red cast commits by naming its paths
intention: The tester's red cast commits by naming its paths, so the commons' path check passes it and the next red in the run casts instead of being held.
why: Measured 2026-11-16 sealing two red proofs from the component-color-reseals worktree: both casts (f9c7ac6a69ba, 6fb272ba3d64) landed in the worktree's commons and both commits were refused by the commons' pre-commit hook ('artifact check: commit names its paths ... another session's staged work is in this index (index)'). red_tickets._commit stages by name and then runs a plain git commit -q -m, which hands the hook the shared index, and check_shared_index (ticket 23c822fe8095) refuses it. Each run raised RedTicketRefused and left its cast staged; the second proof's run then took that staged cast for another writer's work and held its red (_hold) instead of casting it.
traces_to: Law 7 and outline 9.4.2.3.7.5 (reds don't get lost): a red the tester measured lands as a committed ticket, never as staged dirt that also stops the next red.
how: In red_tickets._commit the commit step becomes ['commit', '-q', '-m', message, '--', *named]. A red-first proof arms a scratch commons' pre-commit with check_shared_index and casts one red, then two in sequence.

clauses.claim: a red cast under the commons' armed path check makes one commons commit carrying the cast, with nothing left staged
a second red cast after the first in the same process casts and commits too, and nothing is held

decisions.text: D1: red_tickets._commit's commit step names its paths: git commit -q -m <message> -- <named>. Stage-by-name and no-push (207c4074b3d5 D7) stand.
D2: the red-first proof copies the world of test_red_tickets_asks_the_commons_git_not_the_hooks.py and arms the scratch commons' pre-commit with check_shared_index; one tooth per clause.
